_provenance.field_mapping: 'deliverables' is additive to the declared schema. runner/dev_graph/builder.py reads it and writes a deliverable -> validated_by -> milestone edge, which is how a milestone gathers evidence from more than one work package.
_provenance.scope_note: Eight milestones. The verifiable criterion here names the evidence that must exist; Phase 4 assigns the responsible party and reconciles the criterion with the finished Gantt (CLAUDE.md §7 Phase 4).

milestones.title: Knowledge gaps prioritised
milestones.verifiable_criterion: The gap analysis is delivered and names, in priority order, the biodiversity knowledge gaps the three cases will address and the data each one needs.

milestones.title: Architecture and joint protocols agreed
milestones.verifiable_criterion: The integration architecture, the case selection and the joint collection, metadata and processing protocols are all delivered, and every partner running a campaign has adopted the protocol in writing.
milestones.note: The gate before any campaign starts. A case run under a protocol that changes later produces data the other two cases cannot join.

milestones.title: All three campaigns running under the joint protocol
milestones.verifiable_criterion: The terrestrial, freshwater and marine campaigns have each collected at least one field round, the omics sampling protocol is delivered, and the reporting-needs assessment states what the outputs must carry.

milestones.title: Training resource documented and the crosswalks published
milestones.verifiable_criterion: The training and validation resource is published with its split protocol, and the crosswalk package resolves every habitat label the project uses to the European classification and the global typology.

milestones.title: Omics layer joined to the observation record
milestones.verifiable_criterion: The molecular dataset, the genome-to-space linkage report and the processing pipeline release are delivered, and a molecular record can be joined to an in-situ and a satellite record through the published metadata.

milestones.title: Three realms delivered and the models benchmarked
milestones.verifiable_criterion: The three case datasets are delivered under one protocol, and the classification models report benchmark scores on each of them under the declared split.
milestones.note: The second scope requirement is answered here or not at all. Each realm rests on one partner, so losing P07 or P08 removes a realm rather than delaying it.

milestones.title: Cross-case verification complete and the indicators released
milestones.verifiable_criterion: The verification report states which harmonisation decisions survived transfer between realms and which did not, and the indicator decision-support release is available to the user network.

milestones.title: European coverage delivered and the exploitation route settled
milestones.verifiable_criterion: The European-scale maps and trend predictions are published with stated uncertainty, the usability evaluation is reported, and the exploitation plan names the route each output takes after the project.

content.cross_work_package_note: Seven of the eight milestones gather deliverables from more than one work package. That is what makes a milestone a synchronisation point rather than a work package's own end date, and it is what the shadow impact planner has to propagate across when a deliverable moves.

field_status.milestones: Assumed. Derived from the work package schedule, which rests on the operator's duration choice.
field_status.verifiable_criteria: Assumed. Phase 4 confirms each criterion against the finished Gantt and assigns the responsible party formally.
field_status.responsible_partner: Assumed. Every partner's participation is Assumed.
